question: How many gold medals did Suruchi Singh win in 10 m air pistol at ISSF World Cup in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Three**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Indian shooter **Suruchi Singh** delivered an extraordinary performance at the **ISSF World Cup 2025**, which was held in **New Delhi**, **India**.
 
• She successfully won a total of **three gold medals** specifically in the **10 m air pistol** discipline, marking one of the most successful individual runs in the tournament's history. ***Hence, the statement regarding three medals is correct.***
 
• Her first gold medal was secured in the **10m Air Pistol Women's Individual** event, where she outscored competitors from across the globe in the final round at the **Dr. Karni Singh Shooting Range**.
